Starting Balances — Capital Accounts

This guide explains how to set up starting balances for your capital accounts in Manager. Setting up starting balances is essential when you are transferring existing capital balances from a previous accounting system or starting your accounts with opening balances.

Accessing Starting Balances

To set up starting balances for your capital accounts:

  1. Navigate to the Capital Accounts tab on the left sidebar.
  2. Click on the Starting Balances button.

You will be taken to the starting balances screen, which lists any existing starting balances for your capital accounts.

CapitalAccountsNewStartingBalance

Creating a New Starting Balance

To create a new starting balance for a capital account:

  1. Click on the New Starting Balance button.

    This will open the Starting Balance form for capital accounts.

  2. Fill in the necessary details for the capital account's starting balance.

    For detailed instructions on completing the form, see Starting Balance for Capital Account Form.

  3. Click Create to save the starting balance.

By setting up starting balances, you ensure that your capital accounts accurately reflect the amounts as of your start date in Manager.
